name: The Sharpest of Blades
summary: Ember Bladewhisper wants sharpening stones for the Farholde recruits. A seasoned blade can mean the difference between victory and death.

sections.title: Blades for Recruits
sections.body: At the Farholde training grounds, Ember Bladewhisper sees that the recruits know little of the difference between a practice sword and a veteran's well-kept blade. You are asked to bring her sharpening stones so the recruits can learn what a keen edge means.

faq.answer: Ember Bladewhisper at the Farholde training grounds asks for sharpening stones.

faq.q: Why does Ember want the stones?
faq.answer: She wants the recruits to understand how a sharpened blade differs from a training sword.

faq.q: Where should I bring the stones?
faq.answer: Bring the sharpening stones to Ember Bladewhisper at the Farholde training grounds.

faq.q: What kind of stones does Ember need?
faq.answer: Ember asks for Solid Sharpening Stones.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Sharpest of Blades
